designationHistory.name: Pablo Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1921 by President Warren G. Harding's Executive Order 3504 as the Pablo Reservation, a bird refuge on a Flathead irrigation reservoir, subject to reservoir uses.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Pablo National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, May 18, 2017 (2017-10111): Ninepipe and Pablo NWRs "were each established as easement refuges in 1921"
American Presidency Project / Wikisource: Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940 (renaming federal wildlife refuges; lists originating orders)

review.note: EO 3504 (Pablo Reservation) per Proclamation 2416, which renamed it Pablo National Wildlife Refuge in 1940. Exact day of EO 3504 not found in an independent source; date left at 1921.
